lines.text: All the nations are called to praise the LORD because His loving devotion toward us is great.
Israel, the house of David, and those who fear the LORD are each called to say His loving devotion endures forever.
The nations surrounded him and swarmed like bees, but in the name of the LORD he cut them off.
He asks for the gates of Zion to be opened so he may give thanks, and the rejected stone becomes the cornerstone.
He prays for the LORD to save us, and says the LORD is God, who has made His light shine upon us.
